scripts.build: tsc -v && vite build --mode production && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); if (require('fs').existsSync('styles.css')) require('fs').copyFileSync('styles.css', 'dist/styles.css')"
scripts.compliance: npm run lint && npm run dry
scripts.test:compliance: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:fix && npm run dry && vitest run tests/6_Compliance.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && wdio run wdio.conf.mts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:fix && npm run dry && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.release: npm version patch && git push origin --follow-tags
